strain_tink: Heavy steel beam creaking under extreme strain, then a single sharp high metallic tink, large empty hall reverb
hit_low: Deep cinematic sub boom impact with long dark tail, documentary trailer hit, no music
whoosh_soft: Soft airy cinematic whoosh transition, subtle, clean
tick_ui: Single soft precise mechanical click, like a measuring instrument
stamp: Rubber stamp pressed firmly onto paper on a wooden desk, single thud
weld_crack: Steel weld seam cracking and tearing under load, sharp metallic snap and groan, no explosion
rumble: Distant heavy low rumble of a structure giving way, muffled, deep, no screams, no voices
hall_ambience: Large hotel atrium ambience with a big crowd murmuring softly and distant big band music, muffled, reverberant
clock_tick: Slow mechanical wall clock ticking in a quiet room
hydraulic: Laboratory hydraulic press slowly applying load to steel, mechanical hum and creak
chapter_tick: Soft cinematic tick with a short reverse swell, minimal, for a title card
